Subject: High-throughput audit logs / residency question

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We ran the ingest estimate with our security team and need a concrete pricing outline for a high-frequency audit-log workload to quote into our procurement stack. A few data points from our side: 
- Expected ingest: ~3.5 TB/day (peak bursts up to ~7TB/day for 3–6 hours)
- Average events/sec: ~15k EPS during peaks
- Retention: 13 months (regulatory requirement for a subset of logs)
- Residency: Entire stack must be resident in EU (data-at-rest and processing)
- Encryption: We need either customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) or an HSM-backed managed key option.
- HIPAA: We’re HIPAA-covered entity; will need confirmation of controls but prefer HSM for key custody if required.

Please send: (1) a pricing model for ingest + retention (metered and committed options), (2) incremental cost for KMS vs HSM, (3) any onboarding or implementation fees, and (4) a sample SOW + timeline for pilot -> production. We’re aiming to finalize procurement by end of month.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it’s easier.

Samantha Norr

Jonas / Ben —

Drafted three clean pricing pathways for NovaFile. Numbers are conservative; we can flex credits for a PO commitment. Notes and assumptions are at the top of the CSV attached (auditlog-cost-model.csv). Highlights below.

Option A — Metered (no commit)
- Ingest: €0.125 / GB ingested (first 30 days 10% pilot discount)
- Retention storage: €0.006 / GB / month for archive beyond 90 days (tiered by volume)
- KMS: CMEK support (no additional per-month unless using customer KMS requests at scale)
- HSM-managed key (Redwood-hosted HSM pool): €4,250 / month for a single HSM seat (includes 100k HSM ops/mo). Overages: €0.05 / HSM-op beyond bundle. EU residency adds 18% surcharge to above line items to cover dedicated regional infra.

Option B — Committed throughput (12-month)
- Commit tiers: up to 50TB/month: €0.095 / GB ingested (committed), up to 200TB/month: €0.078 / GB
- Retention: included for first 180 days; archive pricing discounted 25% vs metered
- HSM: discounted seat €3,400 / month with 12-month commit
- One-time onboarding credit: we amortize onboarding fee (normally €45k) and offer €20k credit against first 3 invoices for 12-month committal.

Option C — Hybrid (pilot credit + step-up commit)
- 3-month pilot capped at 10TB/day: flat €9,500 / month (includes 1 HSM seat at reduced rate)
- If move to 12-month commit within pilot window, apply a one-time credit equal to 20% of pilot fee to month 1 of committed plan

Other commercial items:
- SLA: Standard Redwood platform SLA (99.9%) for API + ingest; we can include a tailored uptime SLA for HSM-backed keys in EU for an additional fee.
- Evidence & compliance: We’ll supply SOC2 report and EU-data-flow diagram in the SOW. HSM attestation: we can provide vendor certificate and key-handling diagram.

I attached the CSV and sample SOW (SOW-draft-v2.pdf) with timeline (pilot 2 weeks prep + 2–4 week pilot).

If they want deeper discounts, Ben — recommend we reserve up to a 10% concession for commercial sign-off tied to a returnable PO or accelerated payment terms.

— Marissa
Director, Enterprise Pricing
Redwood Inference

Samantha —

Thanks for the detail. We reviewed with pricing and legal and attached a short cost model + SOW for pilot. High level options below (full line items are in the attached CSV):

- Metered (no commit): €0.125/GB ingest + retention charges; EU residency surcharge ~18%
- Committed (12mo): €0.078–0.095/GB depending on tier, onboarding credit available (we can amortize onboarding cost across first three invoices)
- Pilot-to-commit pathway: 3-month pilot flat fee (capped), credit if you convert to 12mo within pilot window

KMS vs HSM: CMEK (customer-provided KMS) is supported; we treat CMEK requests as standard with no per-op charge unless cross-region key operations exceed 100k ops/mo. HSM-managed keys are available as a separate add-on (recommended if your compliance team requires HSM-backed key custody). HSM add-on pricing is per-seat as described by Marissa — we can provide a vendor attestation in the SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-minute call this week to walk options with your security and procurement (I’m available Thu/Fri mornings CET)
2) If acceptable, we’ll send a formal quote + DocuSign for pilot and preferred commit path
3) Onboarding kickoff: 2-week prep calendar followed by pilot

Attachments: auditlog-cost-model.csv, SOW-draft-v2.pdf (see attached).

Would you like me to put a constrained commercial concession on the quote (10% off for first 6 months if they sign a 12-month PO)? We can do that but it requires finance sign-off.

Samantha —

Quick follow-up to answer the three items from security/legal and confirm a commercial pathway.

1) HSM location & isolation- Our managed HSM pool for customers electing the HSM add-on is physically provisioned in our EU region (single-tenant HSM instances provisioned per customer where requested). We will provide the HSM vendor attestation and crypto-isolation diagram in the final SOW. We can also include an availability target in the SOW (we typically offer 99.95% for managed HSM service in-region; higher SLAs can be quoted).

2) CMEK with Azure Key Vault- CMEK using Azure Key Vault in EU does not require extra private link in the majority of deployments — we support both public-authorized key usage and private-link arrangements. If you prefer a private-link setup for key operations, that adds ~3–5 days to onboarding and requires a peer/private endpoint configuration on your side; we’ll include step-by-step network requirements in the SOW.

3) 13-month retention export risk- For on-demand audit exports: incremental storage costs are as per the retention pricing, and large short-notice exports may incur temporary egress load which we treat as standard egress (we can pre-provision expedited export capacity under a short-term burst plan). If you expect frequent short-notice exports we recommend the committed throughput path (reduces per-GB cost and gives predictable export economics).

Commercial concession- We can offer a one-time 10% operational credit against invoices for the first 6 months if NovaFile signs a 12-month PO by Apr 30, 2027. I’ve placed the concession on hold pending PO; if you confirm, we’ll generate a DocuSign that incorporates the concession and the pilot-to-commit pathway.

Next steps:

- Confirm interest in the 12-month concession and sign PO to lock pricing
